FAILED_BREAKOUT_LIQUIDITY_REJECTION.hypothesis: A closed-candle breakout failure exposes trapped directional liquidity.
FAILED_BREAKOUT_LIQUIDITY_REJECTION.economicLogic: A failed acceptance beyond a recent range level can create forced exits and short-horizon reversal flow.
FAILED_BREAKOUT_LIQUIDITY_REJECTION.detector: Prior closed candles probe and close beyond a 20-bar level; the current closed candle rejects back through that level.

SUPPORT_BREAKDOWN_RETEST.hypothesis: A support breakdown followed by a bounded retest can expose overhead supply.
SUPPORT_BREAKDOWN_RETEST.economicLogic: Former support becomes an invalidation reference after trapped longs test it from below.
SUPPORT_BREAKDOWN_RETEST.detector: A prior closed candle breaks a 20-bar floor and the current closed candle retests and rejects that floor.

TREND_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION.hypothesis: A bounded pullback inside an established higher-timeframe trend may resume the prevailing flow.
TREND_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION.economicLogic: A controlled reset can improve entry location while trend alignment supplies directional continuation pressure.
TREND_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION.detector: Closed-candle trend alignment, bounded pullback depth, and directional re-acceleration; no next-bar fields are read.

VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION.hypothesis: A measured release from compressed range can produce a directional event before late chasing.
VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION.economicLogic: Stored range energy plus participation can create temporary order-flow imbalance.
VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION.detector: Closed compression/range statistics followed by closed-candle range and participation expansion.

CROSS_MARKET_DOWNSIDE_MOMENTUM.hypothesis: Synchronous benchmark weakness can improve the base rate of local downside momentum events.
CROSS_MARKET_DOWNSIDE_MOMENTUM.economicLogic: Cross-market risk reduction can reinforce local supply and reduce isolated-symbol mean reversion.
CROSS_MARKET_DOWNSIDE_MOMENTUM.detector: Already-closed BTC/ETH regime context, breadth, and local bearish momentum only.
